name: YCoCg Color Space Rectification
aliases: Color Space Selection for History Rectification
YCoCg Color Space Rectification — YCrCb Rectification
definition: Transforming colors into a luminance-chrominance color space (YCoCg or YCrCb) before applying history rectification to orient the bounding box in the direction of luma, reducing color-related ghosting artifacts.
summary: YCoCg Color Space Rectification is a TAA technique that transforms colors to luminance-chrominance space before clamping, decoupling channels to prevent color bleeding and ghosting artifacts in volumetric rendering.
